issues.description: The public tracked_from_unused_owner axiom constructs a metadata owner and asserts the entire region invariant without any precondition, even while guaranteeing that the region slot map is unchanged.
issues.rationale: The complete axiom has no requires clause. Its from_unused_owner postcondition includes regions.inv() and regions.slots == old_regions.slots. MetaRegionOwners::inv requires every index in [0,max_meta_slots()) to have a slot owner and corresponding slot permission. Thus an input region missing one required slot cannot be repaired to satisfy inv while keeping slots unchanged, yet the axiom exports that guarantee without requiring initial validity. It also returns a generic M::Owner without taking one as input. This is not inferred merely from the use of axiom: the unchanged-map and unconditional-validity clauses give the concrete incompatible state condition. The direct child repair replaces the axiom with a checked constructor that consumes meta_own and repr_perm and returns their wrapper, removing the arbitrary region-state guarantee. Its from_unused caller is updated to receive and pass the real metadata owner. No runtime memory corruption or full verifier reproduction is claimed; LinkOwner itself has only ghost fields in this revision, so no specific LinkOwner pointer-permission duplication is alleged.
